in_marathi.name: Ayanav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayanav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayanav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ayan', which means 'radiant' or 'joyful'. This name is associated with the god Ayyappan, a deity worshipped in Kerala, India, known for his healing powers. The name is believed to bring happiness and prosperity.
